newsitem.title: USA: USDA OK's $5 mln FY97 credit guarantee for Jamaica.
newsitem.headline: USDA OK's $5 mln FY97 credit guarantee for Jamaica.

text.p: The U.S. Agriculture Department said Tuesday that it authorized $5 million in credit guarantees for sales of U.S. farm products to Jamaica under the Commodity Credit Corp's Supplier Credit Guarantee Program for fiscal year 1997.
USDA said this is an adaptation of the GSM-102 program and is designed to assist exporters who wish to provide relatively short-term credits to their importers.

U.S. products for sale under the authorization include varieties of fresh and canned fruits and vegetables, dried fruits and frozen vegetables. They also include wines and brandy, processed meat products, lecithin, processed soybean protein products, tree nuts, peanuts, potatoes and dairy products.

Sales must be registered by Sept 30, 1997, and exports must be made no later than Nov 30, 1997. Guarantee fee rate is $0.95 per $100 of coverage, based on guaranteed value, for all credit terms covered.
